description: Natural requests to see or drive a TV or Android phone. The operator's complaint was that none of these found the device-control skill, so the agent said it could not do them. Pass = a device-control skill is in the top 5 of a `--type library,skill,command` query.

cases.query: show me a screenshot of the home page of my TV
take a screenshot of my TV
what is on my TV screen right now
open YouTube on the living room TV
test my app on my android phone
install the apk on my phone and screenshot it
what app is running on my TV
open the settings app on my android phone
open the YouTube app on my TV, search for a video and tell me what is playing
walk through the sign-in flow of my app on the android phone and capture each screen
